input.name: fields
input.label: Output field list
input.hint: A sample schema structure of the response returned by the API call. This is used to generate the output datatree for field mapping in subsequent steps.

input.name: search_query
input.label: Search query
input.hint: Learn more about search queries here . Example: sourcetype=access_* status=200 | top categoryId .

input.name: earliest_time
input.label: Earliest time
input.hint: Use this to search for events that occurred after a specific time.

input.name: latest_time
input.label: Latest time
input.hint: Use this to search for events that occurred before a specific time. Defaults to current time.

input.name: payload
input.label: Payload
input.hint: Example, data to be sent in key=value format

input.name: index
input.label: Index
input.hint: The name of the repository for Splunk to store the event in.

input.name: source
input.label: Source
input.hint: The source value to assign to the event data. For example, if you're sending data from an app you're developing, you could set this key to the name of the app.

input.name: sourcetype
input.label: Sourcetype
input.hint: The sourcetype value to assign to the event data. It identifies the data structure of an event. A source type determines how Splunk formats the data during the indexing and also parses the data during…

input.name: host
input.label: Host
input.hint: The host value to assign to the event data. This is typically the hostname of the client/server/service from which the data came from.
